name: Teen Connection Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Teens volunteer in the children's hospital. They help kids and families waiting for procedures. They also staff the gift shop, work the information desk or help at special events.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 15 to 19 pick the Teen Connection type on the application. The page does not list a city or school rule.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The application says services are donated and there is no payment.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: Application form is on the site now. No deadline stated. The hospital says the most need is Monday through Friday in business hours, with few evening or weekend spots.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online volunteer application form. Choose Teen Connection. For questions call Children's Nebraska. Use the phone number on the volunteer page.
notes: The application form asks for a Social Security number, a date of birth and an emergency contact. The same page also lists KIDS Nebraska. It is for young people ages 13 to 18 in Nebraska and western Iowa. No prior medical experience is needed.
